objective: Resolve the 112 frontend financial arithmetic findings from C48 with explicit disposition

false_positive_regex_patterns.description: Regex literals containing digit patterns (e.g., \d{2}, [\d,]+\.\d{2}) incorrectly flagged as monetary arithmetic. These are parsing patterns, not computations.
false_positive_regex_patterns.disposition: FALSE_POSITIVE - No remediation needed. Lint rule limitation: cannot distinguish regex patterns from arithmetic expressions.
false_positive_regex_patterns.evidence: All 15 findings are in directPattern regex literals in BANK_METADATA_CONFIG

false_positive_test_fixtures.description: Test code, mock data, and test fixtures containing sample financial calculations. These are not production code paths.
false_positive_test_fixtures.disposition: FALSE_POSITIVE - No remediation needed. Test fixtures intentionally contain financial calculations for test validation.

intentional_display_calculations.description: Credit card utilization percentage calculation for UI display. This is a pure presentation-layer computation converting backend paise values to percentage for display.
intentional_display_calculations.disposition: APPROVED_EXCEPTION - Intentional frontend display calculation. Backend returns raw paise; frontend computes utilization % for UI. Documented with justification.
intentional_display_calculations.evidence: Single finding at line 64: ((credit_limit_paise - available_paise) / credit_limit_paise) * 100
intentional_display_calculations.justification: Pure presentation logic. Backend owns monetary arithmetic; frontend only formats for display. No monetary decisions made.

simulator_arithmetic.description: Financial simulators performing projections, EMI calculations, budget averaging, emergency fund targets. These are 'what-if' planning tools, not transactional arithmetic.
simulator_arithmetic.disposition: ARCHITECTURAL_EXCEPTION - Simulators are planning/projection tools. They operate on user-provided inputs for scenario modeling. Backend APIs should provide canonical calculations; simulators are advisory only.
simulator_arithmetic.evidence: Loan EMI calculations, budget averaging, emergency fund targets, cashflow projections, standard deviation calculations
simulator_arithmetic.remediation: Add explicit documentation that simulator outputs are estimates. Ensure backend APIs are source of truth for actual financial operations.
simulator_arithmetic.action: Add JSDoc comments to each simulator function clarifying advisory nature

intelligence_engine_ratios.description: Business intelligence engines computing ratios (savings rate, debt-to-income, risk scores, allocation percentages). These are derived metrics for UI dashboards.
intelligence_engine_ratios.disposition: ARCHITECTURAL_EXCEPTION - Derived metrics for display/analysis. Backend should own canonical calculations; frontend computes derived ratios for real-time UI responsiveness. No monetary mutations.
intelligence_engine_ratios.evidence: Savings/income ratios, debt/income ratios, risk score averaging, allocation percentages, spending averages, progress percentages
intelligence_engine_ratios.remediation: Add backend API endpoints for canonical metric computation. Frontend versions are fallback for offline/real-time UI. Document as derived/display-only.
intelligence_engine_ratios.action: Add JSDoc comments clarifying derived nature. Create backend capability tickets for canonical metric APIs.

graph_metrics_percentages.description: Graph metric percentage calculations for visualization (count/total * 100). Pure display formatting.
graph_metrics_percentages.disposition: APPROVED_EXCEPTION - Pure visualization formatting. No financial decisions.
graph_metrics_percentages.justification: Display-only percentage formatting for chart labels

graph_types.description: Type definition line flagged incorrectly - 'has_statement' is a string literal in a union type, not arithmetic.
graph_types.disposition: FALSE_POSITIVE - Lint rule false positive on type definition syntax.
